definitions.explanation: The customs, arts, and achievements of a particular society.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{文化|ぶんか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{興味|きょうみ}→興味：01316_kyoumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{文化|ぶんか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{理解|りかい}する→理解：03674_rikai⟧。
⟦{留学|りゅうがく}して→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧、⟦いろいろな→色々：02352_iroiro⟧{文化|ぶんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}したい→体験：11443_taiken⟧。
examples.english: I want to study abroad and experience various cultures.

notes:
{文化|ぶんか} means culture - the customs, arts, beliefs, and way of life of a society or group.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {日本|にほん}{文化|ぶんか}: Japanese culture
- {文化|ぶんか}の{違|ちが}い: cultural differences
- {文化|ぶんか}を{学|まな}ぶ: to learn about culture
- {文化|ぶんか}{交流|こうりゅう}: cultural exchange

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {文化的|ぶんかてき}: cultural (な-adjective)
- {文化祭|ぶんかさい}: cultural festival (school event)
- {文化遺産|ぶんかいさん}: cultural heritage
- {異文化|いぶんか}: different culture, foreign culture

NOTE:
{文化|ぶんか}の{日|ひ} (Culture Day) is a Japanese national holiday on November 3rd, celebrating cultural achievements.
